Kabaddi Raid

3D kabaddi for your phone · Raid, touch and race home

  • 7 v 7
  • 8 languages
  • Offline
  • No ads

Kabaddi Raid is a 3D kabaddi game for your phone. Cross the baulk line on one breath, touch a defender and race back over the midline before they bring you down.

Or defend: read the raid, take him by the ankle, the thigh or the waist, and chain up with a team-mate.

Join the beta
Play in your browser

▶ Coming soon to Google Play

Features

Three ways to play

Quick Match, a League Season with your own franchise and the player auction, and the Nations Cup.

Raid and tackle

Hand and toe touches, kicks, the dubki and the lion jump; ankle, thigh and waist holds and chain tackles.

The rules as played

Bonus points, revivals, all outs, do-or-die raids, super tackles and the golden raid, with referees signalling every call.

Breath or the clock

Raid on one breath of the cant, or against the 30-second clock: your choice.

Five grounds

Twelve franchises, twelve countries and five grounds, from a village mat to a stadium under lights.

Controls your way

A stick wherever your thumb lands, a left-handed layout, movable buttons and four levels from Rookie to Legend.

About the sport

Kabaddi is a contact team sport from South Asia, played seven a side. A raider crosses into the other half, touches as many defenders as he can and must get back over the midline before they bring him down, either on one breath while chanting the cant or against a 30-second clock. Defenders score by stopping him: ankle holds, thigh holds, chain tackles.

pages.title: Kabaddi Raid privacy policy
pages.content:
The same policy is in the game: Settings > About > Privacy policy. Questions about the game itself: Kabaddi Raid help.

Last updated 27 October 2026. Kabaddi Raid is a kabaddi game for Android phones and tablets, made by Josh Nason.

In short

Kabaddi Raid does not collect, send, share or sell any personal data. There is no account, no advertising, no analytics and no tracking. The Android app does not have permission to use the internet: everything you do in the game stays on your phone.

What the game keeps, and where

In its own private storage on your phone, and nowhere else: your settings (language, sound and volume, vibration, graphics, camera, controls, difficulty) and your saved games (your League Season and your Nations Cup). Other apps cannot read them, they are not sent anywhere, and they are not part of your phone's cloud backup. Uninstalling the game deletes them; updating it keeps them.

Permissions

The game asks for one permission: vibration, so the phone can buzz at a tackle or a point (you can turn it off in Settings). It does not ask to use the internet, your location, contacts, camera, microphone, photos or files. Everything the game shows, these pages included, comes with it.

Links

A few buttons (View online on this page and on Help) open a page in your phone's web browser. The game sends nothing when you tap one; the page is covered by the policy of the site it is on.

The browser version

A version of the game also runs in a web browser, at kabaddi-raid-beta.netlify.app. That page is served by Netlify, which keeps standard server logs (such as your IP address and browser type) under Netlify's privacy policy. The game sends nothing to us there either; its settings and saved games stay in your browser's storage on your device.

Children

Kabaddi Raid is a sports game for players of all ages. It collects no personal information from anyone, children included.

Changes

If this policy changes, the new version comes with the game and is posted online, with a new date. If the game ever starts to collect any data, the policy will say so before the update that does it is released.

Contact

Questions about this policy or the game: https://thekabaddipulse.com/contact/

pages.title: Kabaddi Raid help and support
pages.content:
Help for Kabaddi Raid. The same help is in the game: Settings > About > Help.

Something not working, or an idea for the game? Tell us through our contact page, with your phone's model and what happened. A screenshot helps.

Playing

How do I raid?

Move with the stick on the left of the screen (put your thumb down anywhere there). Cross the baulk line, touch a defender with Hand touch or Kick, then get back over the midline before your breath (or the raid clock) runs out. Dodge, Dubki and Lion jump get you out of a tackle; if you are caught, Break free lights up. How to Play, on the home screen, goes through every move and rule.

How do I defend?

You control one defender (tap another player to switch). Hold the raider with Ankle, Thigh or Waist, or Dash him out of the court. Chain links you with a team-mate for a chain tackle.

What are the modes?

  • Quick Match: two teams, one ground, play now.
  • League Season: own a franchise. Keep your best players, win the auction, then the league and the final, season after season.
  • Nations Cup: pick a country and its squad of twelve, through the groups to the final.

How do I change the language?

Tap the language button on the home screen. The game speaks English, Hindi, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Bengali and Punjabi, and starts in your phone's language if it is one of them.

Your phone

The game is slow or jerky

Open Settings and set Graphics to Medium or Low. The game also lowers it by itself if your phone cannot keep up, and says so on screen.

Will I lose my season if I update?

No. Updates keep your settings and saved games. Uninstalling the game deletes them, because they are kept only on your phone (see the privacy policy).

Measuring a problem for us

Tap the version number on the home screen seven times to turn on the developer's overlay. Play until the problem happens, tap Copy summary and paste it into your message. Seven more taps turn it off.

Is there an iPhone version?

Not yet. The browser version, at kabaddi-raid-beta.netlify.app, plays on an iPhone, iPad or computer: turn a phone sideways, and tap once to start the sound.

Contact

Through our contact page: thekabaddipulse.com/contact.

Beta downloads

The Android beta is on the game's release page on GitHub. How to install a beta.

Hurling Heroes

Ireland's ancient field sport · Iománaíocht

  • 15 v 15
  • English · Gaeilge
  • Offline
  • No ads
  • HD pack

Hurling Heroes is hurling for your phone, Ireland's ancient field sport: the clash of the ash, fifteen a side, goals and points.

Play on a parish field at dusk or in front of a full stadium. Lift the sliotar, solo through, and strike it over the bar.

Join the beta

▶ Coming soon to Google Play

Features

The 2026 playing rules

Two halves of 35 minutes, a goal worth three points, puck-outs, frees, 65s, sideline cuts and penalties.

Solo and strike

Four steps with the sliotar in your hand, then solo it on your hurley.

Every official on the field

The referee whistles and shows cards; linesmen flag sideline cuts; umpires wave white for a point, green for a goal.

The Summer Championship

Two groups of five, then knock-outs to the final; the other ten counties play the Tier Two Cup.

As Gaeilge

English or Irish, with the game's own Irish terms: camán, sliotar, cúl, cúilín, poc amach.

Graphics for your phone

Low, Medium and High, changed any time, plus an optional HD download for recent high-end phones.

About the sport

Hurling is Ireland's ancient field sport, played fifteen a side. Players carry an ash stick, the hurley (camán), and a small leather ball, the sliotar, which can be caught, balanced on the stick while running, or struck the length of the field. A goal under the bar is worth three points; a point goes over the bar between the posts.

Privacy policy · Help and support · Licences · Press kit

Hurling Heroes is an independent game. It is not connected with or endorsed by any sporting body, county board or club. The counties appear by their place names, in colours of the game's own design; every player is invented.

pages.title: Hurling Heroes help and support
pages.content:
Help for Hurling Heroes. The same help is in the game: Settings > About > Help.

Playing

  • Your player has the gold ring. Your left thumb anywhere on the left of the screen runs him; the buttons on the right are what he can do now. SWITCH changes him to the teammate best placed for the ball.
  • With the sliotar: STRIKE shoots for a point (or, with the joystick pushed another way, strikes a long ball to the teammate there); GOAL, close in, drives it low for the net; PASS hand-passes it; SOLO puts it on your hurley before your four steps are up (the dots over your player count them), and HAND takes it back, your second and last catch.
  • Without it: CATCH or LIFT it when it comes near, PULL to strike it first time; near the man on the ball, TACKLE, and BLOCK when he goes to strike.
  • Restarts: your puck-out LONG or SHORT; your free, 65 or sideline cut STRIKE at the posts or PASS; a penalty, aim and GOAL.
  • Too much to manage? Settings > Help with the ball > Full: your player solos by himself and runs for loose balls when your thumb is off the joystick.

The rules

The game plays the playing rules of hurling in force in 2026: two halves of 35 minutes (30 at club level), a goal worth three points, four steps and two catches, the 13-metre and 20-metre rules at restarts, yellow and red cards, the black card and sin bin for denying a goal chance, extra time and penalties in knock-out games. How to Play in the game has the whole of it.

If something is wrong

  • The game runs slowly or the phone gets warm: Settings > Graphics > Low, and Frame rate > Battery saver. Phones with less memory start on Low by themselves.
  • The beta will not install on an older or Android Go phone: use the file ending in -32bit.apk from the beta page.
  • The Irish looks wrong (an bhfuil an Ghaeilge mícheart?): please tell us which screen and what it says; we want it right.
  • The buttons are hard to reach: Settings > Button size, Move buttons to drag them where you want them, and Left-handed to swap the sides.

Get in touch

Email joshnason8@gmail.com with your phone's model and what happened. We read everything.

Sepak Takraw Unleashed

The kick volleyball of Southeast Asia

  • 3 v 3
  • 13 languages
  • Offline
  • No ads

Sepak Takraw Unleashed is sepak takraw for your phone: the kick volleyball of Southeast Asia.

Serve with a foot in the circle, receive with the inside of your foot, set it high by the net, and launch a roll spike over the block.

Join the beta

▶ Coming soon to Google Play

Features

The laws as today

Sets to 15 (win by two, up to 17), best of three, serve alternating every point, three touches a side.

Every event

Regu, quadrant, doubles and the team event, for men and women, on a court and net to exact measurements.

The moves fans know

Sepak sila, the instep dig, the header, the horse-kick serve, the roll spike, the sunback, the feint and the block.

Officials and video challenge

Faults called by the referee, line judges' calls, and a video challenge to overturn them.

Leagues and internationals

Club seasons in Malaysian, Thai and Indonesian formats; the World Championship, Royal Cup, Asian and Southeast Asian championships.

Nothing played for you

Run your player to the ball with the joystick and kick as the ring closes on it.

About the sport

Sepak takraw is the kick volleyball of Southeast Asia. Players keep a small ball in the air with their feet, knees, chest and head, never their hands, and send it over a net on a badminton-sized court, with at most three touches a side. The main event, the regu, is three a side: the tekong serves from the circle and strikers attack with acrobatic overhead spikes.

Sepak Takraw Unleashed is an independent game. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by any sepak takraw federation, league, club or player. The clubs' nicknames are invented and the players are fictional; the countries, places and rules are real.

pages.title: Sepak Takraw Unleashed help and support
pages.content:
Help for Sepak Takraw Unleashed. The same help is in the game: Settings > About > Help.

Playing

  • Nothing is played for you. The player lit in gold is yours: run him with the joystick to the gold mark on the floor (it turns green when he is close enough), and press as the ring closing on the ball meets the gold circle. Too early, too late or too far away, and he misses it.
  • Serving: Serve for the steady instep serve, Horse kick for the fast sole serve. Aim with the joystick.
  • Setting and spiking: your feeder sets (high for a roll spike, quick for a sunback); your striker spikes. Push the joystick to aim; Feint drops it over the block.
  • Blocking: when they set their striker, Block appears. Slide along the net with the joystick and jump as he hits.
  • Too fast? Settings > Game speed > Slow (the default), and Assist > Full, so your players run to the ball themselves while you time the touches.

The rules

The game plays the laws of sepak takraw as they stand: sets to 15 (from 14-all, win by two, up to 17), best of three, the serve alternating every point, three touches a side. How to Play in the game has the whole of it.

If something is wrong

  • The game runs slowly or the phone gets warm: Settings > Graphics > Low, and Frame rate > Battery saver. Budget phones start on Low by themselves.
  • Words in your language look wrong: please tell us which screen and what it says; the translations are new and we want them right.
  • The buttons are hard to reach: Settings > Button size, and Left-handed to swap the sides.

Take the centre pass, drive into space, feed the circle and shoot, then win the ball back with an intercept.

Features

Seven positions, real areas

Netball is a fast passing game, seven a side, played most in Australia, New Zealand, the UK, southern Africa, the Caribbean and the Pacific. Players may not run with the ball or hold it for more than three seconds, each position keeps to its own areas of the court, and only the Goal Shooter and Goal Attack can score, from inside the circle.

pages.title: Netball Unleashed help and support
pages.content:
Help for Netball Unleashed. The same help is in the game: Settings > About > Help.

Playing

  • Your player has the lime ring at her feet. The joystick (your left thumb, anywhere on the left of the screen) runs her. Lead into space to get free for a pass.
  • With the ball she may not run: that is footwork. Push the joystick toward a team-mate to pick her (a ring shows who), then Pass, or Lob over a defender. The ring over the ball is your three seconds.
  • Shooting: Shoot appears when your Goal Shooter or Goal Attack has the ball in the circle.
  • Defending: Defend puts her arms up. Keep 0.9 m from the landing foot of the player with the ball (the ring round it turns red when you are closer) or the umpire calls obstruction. Intercept leaps for a pass.
  • Team or one position: on the home screen, Team lets you play whoever has the ball; a bib (GS to GK) lets you play that position all match.

The rules

The game plays the Rules of Netball as they stand (2024 edition): seven a side, each in her areas; the centre pass alternating after every goal; footwork, three seconds, obstruction at 0.9 m, contact, offside, over a third, short pass; free passes, penalty passes and the penalty shot; four quarters, and extra time to a two-goal lead when a match must have a winner. How to Play in the game has all of it.

If something is wrong

Kho Kho Rush

The chasing game of India

  • 9 v 9 · 7 v 7
  • 14 languages
  • Offline
  • No ads

Kho Kho Rush is kho kho for your phone: the chasing game of India.

Sit in the lane with your side, rise on a kho, chase the defenders to the pole, and dive to touch them out before the turn runs down.

Join the beta

▶ Coming soon to Google Play

Features

Two rule books

Classic, nine a side as the national championships play it; Fast, seven a side from the 2025 world championship.

Every chaser rule

Keep your direction, never cross the central lane, turn only round a pole, and give the kho from behind.

Touch, sky dive, pole dive

Defenders on in batches of three. Out by a touch, a sky dive, a pole dive or a late entry.

Umpires on both lines

Umpires on both side lines whistle a foul until it is put right, with a referee and a timekeeper.

Championships and City League

Sixteen nations or sixteen states, men's and women's, or eight invented city sides home and away.

Four grounds

A village ground at dusk, a school ground in the morning, an indoor arena on mats, a floodlit stadium.

About the sport

Kho kho is a traditional chasing game from India. The chasing side sits in a line of squares down the middle of the field, with a pole at each end, while one active chaser runs after the defenders. He may not cross the central lane or turn back, so he hands on the chase by touching a seated team-mate from behind and calling "kho".

pages.title: Kho Kho Rush help and support
pages.content:
Help for Kho Kho Rush. The same help is in the game: Settings > About > Help.

Playing

  • Chasing: you are always the active chaser, ringed in gold. The joystick (left thumb, anywhere on the left) runs him; touch a defender and he is out. Run up behind a seated chaser who faces the other side, and when his square lights up press Kho: you become him, rising on the far side of the lane. Dive throws you full length at a defender just out of reach; in the free zone behind a pole it is a pole dive.
  • The direction rule: once you set off toward one pole you may not turn back or cross the lane, except by going round a pole. With Settings > Lane assist on (the default) the game keeps you to it; off, the umpire whistles you.
  • Defending: you run one of the batch of three; Switch takes another and Dodge is a quick burst. Stay behind the active chaser, where he cannot turn, and inside the lines.
  • Too quick? Choose the Beginner difficulty and three-minute turns in the match setup.

The rules

The game plays the national federation's rules (Classic: nine a side, 1 point an out, the follow-on) and the seven-a-side game of the 2025 world championship (Fast: 2 points an out, dream runs, the wazir and the power play). How to Play in the game has the whole of it.

Floorball Unleashed

The fast indoor stick game · Five and a goalkeeper a side

  • 5 v 5
  • 15 languages

Floorball Unleashed is floorball for your phone: the fast indoor stick game of Sweden, Finland, Switzerland and Czechia.

Five and a goalkeeper a side on a 40 by 20 metre rink inside the boards, to floorball's international Rules of the Game in force from 1 July 2026.

Join the beta

▶ Coming soon to Google Play

Features

The 2026 rules

Three periods, face-offs, hit-ins and free-hits, the goalkeeper area, two- and five-minute penalties, power plays and penalty shots.

Two referees

Two referees who whistle and signal every call: free-hit, advantage, delayed penalty, two minutes, passive play, goal.

Pull the goalkeeper

Late in a match the team behind pulls its goalkeeper for a sixth outfield player.

Teams that play floorball

A 2-1-2 defence, flying line changes every fifty seconds, wingers wide and the centre in the slot.

World Finals and club season

Sixteen nations at the World Finals, or ten clubs in a league with 3-2-1-0 points and a final.

A box score

Shots on goal, saves, penalty minutes, power-play goals, every goal and every penalty with its rule.

About the sport

Floorball is a fast indoor stick game, played most in Sweden, Finland, Switzerland and Czechia. Each side has five outfield players and a goalkeeper, on a 40 by 20 metre rink inside low boards. Outfield players use light plastic sticks and a plastic ball with holes; the goalkeeper plays without a stick.

pages.title: Floorball Unleashed help and support
pages.content:
Help for Floorball Unleashed. The same help is in the game: Settings > About > Help.

Playing

  • You play one outfield player, the one with the yellow number; your team-mates and both goalkeepers play themselves. Move with the joystick: put your left thumb down anywhere on the left of the screen.
  • With the ball: Shoot (push the joystick up or down as you press to pick a corner), Pass (to the team-mate the joystick points at), and hold Sprint to run flat out.
  • Without it: Tackle plays your stick at the ball. From the front it often wins it; from behind or on the stick it is a free-hit to them, and a trip or a slash is two minutes. Switch takes over the team-mate nearest the ball.
  • Free-hits and hit-ins: when your player takes one, press Pass or Shoot. You may score straight from either.
  • Too fast? Settings > Game speed > Steady (the default) plays a little slower than real floorball.

The rules

The game plays floorball's international Rules of the Game, the edition in force from 1 July 2026: three periods, five and a goalkeeper a side, free-hits with the 3 metre distance, two-minute penalties that end when the other team scores on the power play, overtime and penalty shots. How to Play in the game has all of it, with the rule numbers and the referees' signs.

Pok Ta Pok Rivals

The hip ballgame of Mexico · Ulama de cadera

  • Hip ball
  • 6 languages
  • Offline
  • No ads

Pok Ta Pok Rivals is the Mesoamerican ballgame on your phone, played as it is still played today.

Strike a heavy rubber ball with your hip across the analco of a long earth court, read its low bounce, dive for it as it skids along the ground, and drive it past the other town's end.

Join the beta

▶ Coming soon to Google Play

Features

Ulama de cadera

The game still played in southern Sinaloa: four or five a side on a strip of packed earth.

The hip only

Touch the ball with anything else and the raya goes to the other side.

The real count

Rayas go up and down, and in urria a whole count can be wiped out. First to eight.

The classic stone court

An I-shaped court rebuilt from the old chronicles, with a stone ring that wins the game outright.

Four courts, sixteen towns

Towns from Sinaloa, the Yucatán, Quintana Roo, Chiapas, Guatemala, Belize and Honduras, each with its own colors.

Team or one player

Play as the whole team, or be one player for the whole match.

About the sport

The Mesoamerican ballgame is more than 3,000 years old. Its living form, ulama de cadera, is still played in villages of southern Sinaloa, Mexico: two sides strike a heavy rubber ball with the hip only along a long strip of packed earth, while judges called veedores keep the count. In the Yucatán and Central America, teams have revived pelota maya on stone courts.

Pok Ta Pok Rivals is an independent game, not connected with or endorsed by any sporting body, federation, tournament or club. Towns appear by their place names only; every player is invented.

pages.title: Pok Ta Pok Rivals help and support
pages.content:
Help for Pok Ta Pok Rivals. The same help is in the game: Settings > About > Help.

Playing

  • Your player has the gold ring. Your left thumb anywhere on the left of the screen moves him; the game hands you the one of your side who goes for the ball.
  • HIP strikes the ball with your hip: tap it just before the ball reaches you (the swing takes a quarter of a second). The ball's shadow shows how high it is; a pale ring on the earth marks where it comes down to hip height in your half.
  • DIVE takes you down to the ground to meet a low or rolling ball with your hip.
  • Aiming: hold the joystick as you strike. Toward their end, a long high ball; back toward yours, a low hard one that skids along the earth; across, to that side.
  • SERVE when your side serves: rolled along the earth when the count is level, thrown high when a side holds it.
  • Too hard? Settings > Help > On: your player goes to meet the ball when your thumb is off the joystick, and the timing is yours.

The rules

Ulama de cadera: the hip only; a raya goes to the other side when the ball dies in your half, goes past your end line, goes out at the side from your strike, or touches one of you anywhere but the hip. One side holds the count at a time: a raya to it adds one, a raya to the other side takes one off, and in urria a raya against it wipes out its whole count. Eight wins. The classic court is a reconstruction: points to eight, the ball plays off the sloped walls, and the ball through a stone ring wins outright. How to Play in the game has the whole of it, with the sources in the game's notes.

If something is wrong

  • The game runs slowly or the phone gets warm: Settings > Graphics > Low, and Frame rate > Battery saver. Phones with less memory start on Low by themselves.
  • The beta will not install on an older or Android Go phone: use the file ending in -32bit.apk from the beta page.
  • A word or a rule looks wrong (¿algo está mal dicho?): if you play or have watched ulama or pelota maya, please tell us; we want it right.
  • The buttons are hard to reach: Settings > Button size, Move buttons to drag them where you want them, and Left-handed to swap the sides.
